datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Zambian administrative units on a monthly basis throughout 2012. The classifications were spatially mapped and stored in geographic formats (GeoJSON, KML) with metadata including collection dates, scenarios, and food security phase assignments. This dataset represents near-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions derived from field assessments.
